sloka: नहि मे जीवितैरर्थो नैवार्थैर्न च भूषणैः ।वसन्त्या राक्षसीमध्ये विना रामं महारथम् ।। ५.२६.५।।।।
transliteration: nahi me jīvitairartho naivārthairna ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।vasantyā rākṣasīmadhye vinā rāmaṁ mahāratham ।। 5.26.5।।।।

translations.english: "In the absence of the great charioteer Rama, of what use is my living in the midst of ogresses? I need no wealth, no ornaments.
